name: Lacustrine-Inselberg
description: This is a world of broad skies and long sightlines, its map written in a subterranean ocean. Travelers navigate by towering mountain ranges and by nothing else, because nothing else stands still.
There is a hush that is not emptiness but attention, as if the landscape were listening back. Visitors report dreams of falling that persist for days after departure.
Trade at the pirate hideout changes hands often and quietly. Its current occupants deal fuel for silence and ask no questions about cargo.
There is money in medicinal compounds here, and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
